edit.warning_item_edit: ⚠ Here: only edit and delete item. Everything else (fields, operations, add new items) — in reference editor.
edit.warning:
⚠ Attention!
- Don't add items if not all fields have been created yet
- There are 2 field types - 'text' & 'number', you can change them if you wish
- Operations work only with the 'number' type and apply to each item in the reference
edit.add_item_hint: Fill what you need. Leave the rest empty.
edit.allowed_vars_rule: Variables must consist only of latin or greek letters, numbers, and underscores.
edit.allowed_vars_curly_hint: If your variable doesn't match these rules, simply wrap it in curly brackets {} — like {Path} or {道}.
